name: confluence.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents.
summary: www.confluence.com scores 61 out of 100 (D). 11 checks fail now, 20 are at risk, and 28 pass. Fix first: certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents.

fix.title: Certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 8 elements on /, /news/square-capital-selects-confluence-revolution-risk-api-to-power-next-generation-risk-analytics/, /asset-managers/, for example .lg\:flex.hidden.py-4 > .logo.mr-6.pl-0. Impact: critical.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: Cookiebot was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw cookies visitor_id1015502 on pardot.com, visitor_id1015502-hash on pardot.com, lpv1015502 on pi.pardot.com, __cf_bm on zoominfo.com, _cfuvid on zoominfo.com.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /news/square-capital-selects-confluence-revolution-risk-api-to-power-next-generation-risk-analytics/, for example #linkedInShare and #twitterShare. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: 1 internal link leads to an error
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 9 elements on /, /news/square-capital-selects-confluence-revolution-risk-api-to-power-next-generation-risk-analytics/, /asset-managers/, for example .h-6.justify-center[target="_blank"]:nth-child(1) and a[href$="ConfluenceTech"].…
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: 58 pages have no meta description
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 267 ms
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
